title: Do you like the Style of the game ? What would you change ?
author: Accomplished-Cat5451
selftext:
Hey there currently building a light MMO  ,  inspired by the game i used to play as a kid Elsword .  
but with a different Style of World and its own lore .

I am happy how the enviroment turned out . I am still learning Blender to Create a better Character  that fits  and has its unique style .

what do you think  any feedback ?

comments.author: nhami
comments.body:
I personally like art style with intricate designs like Genshim Impact, but, this is mostly personal preference.

Art style is a matter of personal preference any what art style fits your game identity no?

replies.author: Accomplished-Cat5451
replies.body: ah okey so you like it more detailed ?  yeah thats true  , english isnt my first language  what i meant is if the whole scene feels like its the same style  idk how to explain it Xd

replies.author: nhami
replies.body:
Yes, the current scene feel like the same identity.

The current style feels like some eastern medieval setting.

comments.author: pirondi
comments.body: Loved the scenario, the character itself it is lacking a bit for me, it feels a bit low resolution. But good enough, dont waste time on small details, i would play.

replies.author: Accomplished-Cat5451
replies.body: Thank you , yes the character is the biggest problem , I am currently learning how to model a character like ragnarok Ro new world or more detailed

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: I think the environments are fantastic.  Cozy, bright, and inviting. The UI and character portrait look good, including the skill icons. It definitely feels like it could be a real MMO from the old days. So I think you nailed it. I think as someone else pointed out, the character model itself is probably the weakest part. But it's also not so terrible and out of place. So at the least, you have a cohesive looking game.

replies.author: Accomplished-Cat5451
replies.body:
Thank you glad to hear that.    
Yeah working on the character .  
I try to recreate the old mmo style but with updated assets  and more cozy but rpg look

comments.author: Aznshorty13
comments.body: Nice. How did you get good walking/running sprites? or is that 3d? Cause its a struggle for me.

replies.author: Accomplished-Cat5451
replies.body: They are still lacking they are 3D rigs

comments.author: Jolly-Rip5973
comments.body:
Honest opinion....

It looks like a mix of Asian and Western Aesthetics and it should look more Asian.  
Even the characters looks white.   
I would use a Naruto run and give him a bit of Samurai, Ronin or Ninja feel. 

I am not exactly sure why it feels European mix, but it does.

replies.author: Accomplished-Cat5451
replies.body:
Ty for the feedback , yeah I get that .   
Character and animations are placeholders I for sure want a Naruto run or air steps and all that Chinese manhua  action

comments.author: Comet7777
comments.body: I think you can level it up by trying to add some sort of lighting aesthetic to it.

replies.author: Accomplished-Cat5451
replies.body: Can you go more into detail ?

replies.author: Comet7777
replies.body: many elements share a similar color palette and value range, so it’s sort of like things blend together even though the style is great. If you add some dynamic lighting and distinct shadows, it will create depth, separate the foreground from the background, and really make the key elements pop
